entries.t: <FACE:00>Ah! Found you at last!<NL>I searched all over!<WAIT>Ikki, I need to talk…

<FACE:91>Ah, you're <PLAYER>!<NL>Sorry about earlier<WAIT>It's been a long time<NL>since a loss that bad<WAIT>I got kind of rattled…<WAIT><FACE:00>I see… losing hits me<NL>hard too…<WAIT>…Hey, how do you know<NL>my name?
<FACE:91>Dr. Medabot told me<NL>of the rampage here…<WAIT>You were the hero!
<FACE:02>A hero? No way…<NL><WAIT>There was Shiden, and<NL>Navico…<WAIT><FACE:00>It was everyone… oh!<NL>
<FACE:00>Are these people here<NL>your friends?<WAIT><FACE:91>Ah, that's right!<NL>
<FACE:91>Let me introduce my<NL>Medafighter friends…<WAIT>Koji
<FACE:94>This guy's a strong<NL>Medafighter?<WAIT>Sure doesn't look it…
<FACE:93>Oh my!<NL>Never judge by looks
<FACE:92>Ikki's been getting a<NL>big head lately<WAIT>That loss was good<NL>medicine for him
<FACE:91>The prim one is Karin…<NL>You met Erika before?
<FACE:92>Hey! Are you saying<NL>I'm not prim?
<FACE:91>And this person is,<NL>um…
<FACE:9D>Bwa ha ha! The Phantom<NL>Renegade is here!!
<FACE:03>I-Ikki… what is this!?
<FACE:91>I told everyone about<NL>our Robattle earlier<WAIT>and now they're all<NL>curious…
<FACE:91><PLAYER>, if you don't<NL>mind…<WAIT>Would you Robattle me<NL>one more time?<WAIT>I'll put up a better<NL>fight than last time!
<FACE:00>A better fight? Come<NL>on!<WAIT>You're all famous<NL>Medafighters!<WAIT>The pleasure's mine!<NL>Let's do it!
<FACE:04>…Ikki?
<FACE:91>Aaah, that felt great!
<FACE:91>There are still strong<NL>Medafighters around!
<FACE:91>Medabots really do run<NL>deep!
<FACE:91>Call me anytime you<NL>want to Robattle!<WAIT>As friends this time!<WAIT><FACE:04>Ah… sure…
<FACE:91>See you!
<FACE:03>Ah!!<NL>W-wait, Ikki!
<FACE:00>Hey, you… no, all of<NL>you. Can we talk?
<FACE:91>Ah, right! You wanted<NL>to talk to me<WAIT>…What is it?
<FACE:00>Does anyone among you<NL>know a guy<WAIT>named Shiden?
<FACE:91>Shiden…? The famous<NL>Medafighter?<WAIT>I've heard of him…<NL>
<FACE:91>Different area, so we<NL>never met at tourneys
<FACE:94>We were going to meet<NL>at the Cluster party…<WAIT>But that mess happened<NL>before it even opened<WAIT>So we've still not met
<FACE:92>From the magazines,<NL>he's quite handsome
<FACE:93>Oh my, looks aren't<NL>everything
<FACE:04>Huh? Where'd that<NL>Renegade fellow go?
<FACE:91>You're right! He was<NL>here a moment ago…<WAIT><FACE:00>Could he be the one<NL>who knows Shiden?
<FACE:91>I couldn't say…

<FACE:91>Oh, I know! Hikaru…<NL>Agata Hikaru, I mean<WAIT>He'd surely know him!<WAIT><FACE:00>Hikaru…<NL>Is he here right now?<WAIT><FACE:91>Yes, he's here! I'll<NL>tell you if I see him<WAIT><FACE:00>Then I'll go look for<NL>this Hikaru…
<FACE:02>Thanks, Ikki
<FACE:91>Ikki joined the team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:94>Koji joined the team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:92>Erika joined the team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:93>Karin joined the team!
